name: CitadelRedeem fixed-rate live-route quotation
summary: CitadelRedeem converted a fixed USDC-denominated staking entitlement to WETH with CamelotRouter.getAmountsOut against the live WETH/USDC pool. Three linked redemptions used that mutable route quote and depleted the treasury while the pool and flash lender gained fees.

loss.notes: Across the three successful redemption receipts, treasury 0x5ed32847e33844155c18944ae84459404e432620 sends 24.842391304488882786 + 16.209329538689066771 + 10.567828449326170156 = 51.619549292504119713 WETH to the helper with no WETH return. Archive balances reconcile each component exactly: 72.668070516983737917 -> 47.825679212494855131 -> 31.616349673805788360 -> 21.048521224479618204 WETH. The linked deposit supplies exactly 2,653 CIT; the three redemptions burn 30.951666666666666666 + 20.265972222222222222 + 13.269386574074074074 CIT, and the withdrawal returns 2,411.306998087592149132 CIT. The exact 241.693001912407850868-CIT net consideration equals 205.187178472222222222 CIT retained by the token contract plus 36.505823440185628646 net burned after a 27.981202022777334316-CIT withdrawal reward mint. CIT is the verified 18-decimal Citadel token. Immediately before the first linked purchase, Camelot CIT/WETH pool 0x73d31c0b326a27a92bdacc7d46f4219c47a022ea held 30,858.676994450283426965 CIT and 25.914525972692246359 WETH, and the EOA held zero CIT. The reserve-implied price is 0.00083978084923578519117074409216673495894624855512076249886196087913167322817030897 WETH per CIT; the consideration is therefore 0.20296915440034811929674252951339791056958896839176185986689155741402339819266159 WETH, worth exactly $458.76509061647484360284823718324789532312485758684757900133898047619466623292721 at the $2,260.27 ETH observation 88 seconds before the purchase. That credit is less than one percent of the pool's WETH-side depth. The three gross WETH products are exactly $56,193.814985453764543677728197041894, $36,653.948853105031488162364539857095 and $23,891.21816681413918017700. Their $116,738.982005372935212017092736898989 sum minus the CIT credit is exact net loss $116,280.21691475646036841424449971574110467687514241315242099866101952380533376707; the shorter numeric fields are IEEE-754 renderings only. In every redemption the quote pool sends and receives the same USDC.e amount exactly (474,961.669570; 475,492.089296; 476,907.393537), gains 1.265909302277494528 + 1.271238817402037529 + 1.274439752872321937 = 3.811587872551853994 WETH, and the external Uniswap V3 lender gains 2.25 WETH per receipt. CitadelRedeem, treasury, staking, owner, EOA and helper each held zero quote-pool LP at anchor minus one; its external LPs therefore incurred no inventory loss. EOA nonces 7-11 are respectively the CIT deposit, three losses and the CIT withdrawal. Nonces 12-21 only approve, dispose, unwrap or forward already measured assets. Separate protocol-owner transactions rescued the treasury's remaining WETH; no attacker or helper transaction ever returned WETH to the treasury. The imported approximately $93,000 figure measured proceeds rather than entity-level loss.

ageReset.description: CitadelRedeem's constructor fixed the treasury, bCIT, USDC.e, WETH and Camelot router, and owner transactions 13-14 seconds later bound CIT and CITStaking. Fixed-rate redemption nevertheless remained disabled because maxRedeemableFixed was zero. This owner call raised slot 0x0a from zero to 20,000 CIT, first activating the fixed path whose USDC-denominated entitlement is converted with the live USDC.e/WETH route quote. No later CIT, staking, treasury, router or fixed-cap setter executed before the campaign; the following max-variable call affects a different branch.

sources.note: Reviewed the complete nonce-7-through-11 campaign receipts and call traces, all WETH, USDC.e and CIT transfers, archive balances, the preceding CIT/WETH pool state and attacker holdings, quote-pool reserves and relevant LP balances, adjacent actor transactions, treasury rescue and return history, verified CitadelRedeem source, direct deployment and runtime history, constructor bindings, every pre-incident call to the target, the maxRedeemableFixed storage transition, and four independently preceding ETH prices. The helper calls CitadelRedeem.redeem(1,0,amount,1) directly in each loss receipt. The target reads a fixed USDC-denominated entitlement from CITStaking, calls CamelotRouter.getAmountsOut over USDC.e to WETH in the same receipt, burns the staked CIT and asks treasury.distributeRedeem to transfer the quoted WETH. The router call therefore treats an atomic mutable pool quote as the treasury redemption invariant; CITStaking, treasury and the standard pools only provide entitlement, custody or market execution and are not the selected defect. The direct 5,375-byte runtime is absent at block 174181516 and has the same 0x60de7c122bda7b2304a58f19d0a202c9fd8b6787abce607550ef964e83ae5c2b hash at creation, fixed-cap activation and anchor minus one. Its EIP-1967 implementation and beacon slots are zero and the loss trace contains no delegatecall from it. The deployment receipt creates the target top-level from the protocol owner. Storage slot 0x0a changes from zero to exactly 20,000e18 in source-4; all target transactions from creation through anchor minus one comprise setCIT, setCITStaking, that fixed-cap activation, a later variable-cap change and ordinary redemptions, with no later causal reset. Code age is 1706347536 - 1706304260 = 43,276 seconds. The owner rescue transactions after the third loss move the remaining treasury WETH to protocol or unrelated users and are excluded; exhaustive WETH logs contain no later attacker/helper-to-treasury return.
